fields.title: Wayanad Landslide Relief 2024
fields.description: Emergency relief and rehabilitation for families affected by the massive landslides in Chooralmala and Mundakkai. Funds are allocated for temporary housing, medical expenses, and long-term settlement of displaced survivors.

fields.title: Fresh Meals for Trivandrum Children's Home
fields.description: Ensuring daily nutritious meals for 150 resident children. We provide balanced diets including local produce, milk, and protein to support healthy growth and development.

fields.title: Monsoon Protection Wear Drive
fields.description: Distributing high-quality raincoats, umbrellas, and waterproof footwear to homeless individuals and daily wage workers across Thiruvananthapuram city.

fields.title: Community Medical Camp - Kochi Port
fields.description: Setting up a primary healthcare camp for coastal workers. We require insulin, nebulizers, blood pressure monitors, and basic first-aid supplies.

fields.title: Kuttanad Water Sanitation Project
fields.description: Providing water purification tablets and sanitation kits to families in the low-lying regions of Alappuzha to prevent water-borne diseases during the monsoon surge.

fields.title: Digital Learning for Tribal Schools
fields.description: Equipping rural learning centers with tablets and internet connectivity to bridge the digital divide for students in the tribal belts of Wayanad and Idukki.
